allowed_input_classes: frozen A2 v0.1 acquisition and base-IR implementation
language parser or conservative structured syntax for the canonical seed language subset

Q0_CLOSED_READ_SET.requirement: The qualification executable must enumerate its read-set classes and assert that no materialized mutant path, truth label, expected E2 prediction, operator metadata, fresh target bytes, comments/docstrings, or target/repository semantic specialization is consumed.

Q1_BASE_BINDING.requirement: For every seed, build the frozen A2 v0.1 base IR through the existing acquisition/build_ir path and bind the overlay to its exact base_ir_digest_sha256 and exact acquired source sha256. The overlay must not mutate or reinterpret base nodes or edges.

Q2_D1_DEFINITION_IDENTITY.requirement: Every parameter, assignment/definition, field/representation write, call result, and required cross-boundary temporary admitted by the supported subset receives a content-addressed definition/value-instance identity containing exact provenance and role. Distinct definition sites may not collapse to one value identity.

Q3_D1_REACHING_DEFINITIONS.requirement: Reads bind only to parser/structured-syntax-derived reaching definitions. Definite straight-line writes replace prior reaching state on that successor path; control joins preserve an explicit set of alternatives. Multiplicity must never be erased into a synthetic single value. Unsupported or ambiguous state is explicit and cannot be marked COMPLETE.

Q4_D1_REPRESENTATION_AND_CALL_BINDING.requirement: Representation fields are qualified by representation-instance identity; binding slots preserve argument index/field key/receiver role. Uniquely resolved acquired calls expose actual-to-formal and return-to-call-result lineage; ambiguous resolution remains incomplete.

Q5_D3_EXACT_ANCHOR_MATERIALIZATION.requirement: All 18 frozen seed anchors must uniquely resolve against the exact frozen source bytes and materialize only their declared roles using existing CTV vocabulary: GUARD for GUARD_COMPARISON, EFFECT for EFFECT_BOUNDARY, OUTCOME for SUCCESS_OUTCOME and REJECTION_NO_EFFECT_OUTCOME. The 12 frozen operand binding slots must resolve to explicit versioned value instances.

Q6_D2_CONTROL_COMPLETENESS.requirement: The function/control scope containing each frozen guard/effect/outcome anchor must have parser-derived or validated structured-syntax ENTRY and EXIT control points, explicit true/false branch polarity, PRECEDES succession, GUARDS immediate control relations, return/exit termination, and explicit join representation when paths reconverge. It may be COMPLETE only when every material control transfer in the anchored scope belongs to the supported subset.

Q7_NO_LINE_ORDER_SEMANTICS.requirement: Source line/column positions may establish provenance and deterministic ordering of output bytes, but must not by themselves establish execution order, control dependence, dominance, or must-path semantics.

Q8_PROVENANCE_AND_CONTENT_ADDRESSING.requirement: Every overlay semantic node and edge must be content-addressed and carry exact source provenance or an explicit frozen-anchor provenance reference that itself resolves to exact source bytes. No dangling relation is allowed.

Q9_SEED_ONLY_OBSERVABILITY.requirement: Qualification establishes only that the six canonical seeds expose the D1/D2/D3 observability surface. It must not score consequence regression, consequence stability, safety, mutation recall, or fresh-target performance.

Q10_DETERMINISM.requirement: Two independent executions in one qualification run must produce byte-identical canonical overlay bundle and qualification receipt.

success_condition: PASS only if all Q0-Q10 gates pass for all six canonical seeds without consulting forbidden inputs. Failure or unsupported structure must fail closed rather than be approximated.

authorized: freeze the seed-only overlay implementation and qualification receipts
design a separate mutation-blind anchor-transport protocol
